synthesis.evidence_balance: mixed — extreme own-history de-rate and durable cash/ROIC against a genuine negative revenue inflection and earned peer-fundamental gap.

bull_points.claim: EV/EBITDA sits at 7.5x — the 0th percentile of 20 trailing quarterly closes — and P/LTM EPS at ~13x is at the 1.4th percentile of ~5 years, so on its own history the de-rate is extreme.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ Financials→Multiples 'TEV/LTM EBITDA' Close (latest) — current multiple

bull_points.claim: Absolute EBITDA has RISEN through the margin compression — Dec-2021 1,148 → Mar-2026 LTM 1,337 — so the falling margin % is partly an optical read, not collapsing dollar profit.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ Financials→Income Statement (margin % + absolute EBITDA reconciler)

bull_points.claim: Levered free cash flow of 1,064.2 (LTM Mar-2026) funds an aggressive buyback that cut shares 13.1% in ~1.8 years (77.06M → 66.95M), evidence the de-rate is being met with capital return rather than distress.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ Financials→Cash Flow 'Levered Free Cash Flow' [LTM 12 months Mar-31-2026]

bull_points.claim: ROIC remains ~19.4% LTM (and held 18–20% throughout the period), consistent with a high-return subscription model rather than a structurally impaired one.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ Financials→Income Statement + Segments + Ratios (multi-year columns)

bull_points.claim: Leverage is modest at 1.3x net-debt/EBITDA with 10.1x interest coverage and no maturity wall until 2028, so balance-sheet stress is not the driver of the de-rate.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ Net Debt $1,688M [Q1 Mar-31-2026] ÷ CIQ EBITDA $1,337M [LTM 12 months Mar-31-2026]

bull_points.claim: On a forward NTM basis the gap to peers persists (NTM TEV/EBITDA 6.59 vs peer median 9.66; NTM P/E 9.2 vs median 12.76) — POSE for the human whether this discount is EARNED or RESIDUAL, noting the peer set is HETEROGENEOUS (caps $751M–$119.1B, 159x span) so the median is not a clean benchmark.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ Comparable Analysis→Trading Multiples (name row + Summary Statistics Low/Median/Mean/High)

bear_points.claim: Revenue growth has stalled and turned negative — same-quarter revenue YoY is -1.5% (Q1 Mar-2026 vs Q1 Mar-2025) and LTM revenue 6,474 sits below FY2025's 6,497 — a genuine top-line deceleration, not merely an optical margin artifact.
bear_points.source_ref: CIQ Financials→Income Statement + Segments + Ratios (multi-year columns)

bear_points.claim: EBITDA margin has compressed every year from 24% (2021) to 20% (2025), and against peers the fundamental gap is wide: name margin 21% vs peer-median 31%, rev growth 2% vs 8%, EBITDA growth 2% vs 7% — suggesting much of the discount may be EARNED rather than residual overshoot.
bear_points.source_ref: CIQ Comparable Analysis→Operating Statistics (name vs peer median: growth/margin/leverage/beta)

bear_points.claim: The name has lost ~50% over 180 days while the small-cap market (IWM) gained ~18%, a -68% relative move that is sharply idiosyncratic, not a shared sector swoon.

The Feb-3-2026 gap-down was an earnings event (8-K items 2.02 + 7.01), and consensus revenue revisions are negative (0↑/3↓ last month) with a Hold (3.00) rating, indicating the Street sees a real fundamental reset.

Revenue is heavily concentrated in one segment — Insights is 5,073 of 6,497 (78%) — so the CV growth slowdown and U.S. federal CV erosion ($126M, vast majority renewed in 2025) hit the dominant profit engine.

twin_reference_cases.name: Moody's Corporation
twin_reference_cases.distinguishing_fact: High-margin subscription/recurring-revenue franchise that de-rated sharply on a cyclical issuance/demand slowdown, then re-rated as the recurring base proved durable.

twin_reference_cases.name: FactSet Research Systems Inc.
twin_reference_cases.distinguishing_fact: Subscription information-services model whose multiple compressed on decelerating net-new business amid client budget caution, with retention holding.

twin_reference_cases.name: Cognizant Technology Solutions Corporation
twin_reference_cases.distinguishing_fact: IT-services name that de-rated on a growth air-pocket from deferred client decision-making, then stabilized as spend normalized.

twin_reference_cases.name: Gartner-style government-exposed services peer (e.g. Maximus)
twin_reference_cases.distinguishing_fact: A federal-spend-exposed services book where a sustained government-contraction (DOGE-type) cut compounded into a multi-year top-line impairment rather than a one-off.

twin_reference_cases.name: IHS Markit
twin_reference_cases.distinguishing_fact: Proprietary-data subscription business that traded at a discount to data-analytics peers until the durability of contract value was recognized.

decisive_question.question: Is the revenue deceleration to -1.5% YoY a temporary air-pocket from deferred client decision-making (overshoot, contract value re-accelerates) or the start of a structural top-line impairment in the dominant Insights franchise (earned de-rate, value trap)?

evidence_for.claim: Management states Q1 contract value grew 1% YoY and accelerated from Q4, with ex-federal CV growth of 3.5%, framing the weakness as federal-specific and decision-timing-driven.
evidence_for.source_ref: CIQ transcript(s): Gartner, Inc., Q1 2026 Earnings Call, May 05, 2026.rtf; Gartner, Inc., Q4 2025 Earnings Call, Feb 03, 2026.rtf

evidence_for.claim: Absolute EBITDA rose to 1,337 LTM and ROIC held ~19.4%, consistent with profit-engine durability through the soft patch.
evidence_for.source_ref: CIQ Financials→Income Statement (margin % + absolute EBITDA reconciler)

evidence_against.claim: Same-quarter revenue YoY is outright negative at -1.5% and LTM revenue has ceased growing, while consensus revenue revisions run 0↑/3↓.
evidence_against.source_ref: CIQ Financials→Income Statement + Segments + Ratios (multi-year columns)
